caption: The drawing depicts a decorative black box with an ornate, curved shape and scalloped edges. The surface of the box shows intricate, colorful floral designs on the top, featuring pink, red, and white flowers with green, yellow, and blue leaves and branches. Gold accents form a border around the top surface and appear in elaborate patterns on the front and sides of the box. The box appears to be made of a glossy material, possibly lacquered, and the detailed decorations give it a rich and elaborate appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and beige. The artist’s name, “Francis Law Durand,” is written in small black letters in the lower right corner.
title: Game Box (For Poker Chips)
